question: Does inspecting every product change correctness or action count compared with narrowing candidates first?
scope: Three paired trials of one fixed stock-recovery task. Descriptive observations only; not a model or general prompt ranking.

configs.name: Inspect every product
configs.instructions: Open every product detail page before choosing. Compare fit, battery, noise cancellation and delivered total. Then follow the mission’s requested purchase sequence and complete a qualifying order. Recover if the requested item is unavailable. Verify the final result.

configs.name: Narrow candidates first
configs.instructions: Narrow candidates using visible catalog facts. Inspect only plausible choices and verify every mission constraint and delivered total before ordering. Follow the requested purchase sequence. If stock fails, narrow the alternatives and verify one before retrying. Verify the final result.
